factions.name: Muramite Legion
factions.description: The occupying military empire that rules Kuua. Composed of Kyv archers, Ra'Tuk shock troops, Ixt taskmasters, Nol ritualists, Zun commanders, Pixt engineers, and Ukun war-hounds.
goals: refine Discord war magic and temporal manipulation
use Kuua as a proving ground for mortals and armies

factions.name: Dranik Survivors
factions.description: Remnants of the native Dranik civilization: refugees, resistance cells, lore-keepers, and hidden defenders.
goals: secure safe routes through Kuua’s warzones

factions.name: Riftseekers
factions.description: Arcane entities and scholars dedicated to stabilizing planar rifts and mitigating temporal fractures.
goals: prevent Kuua’s total collapse into Discord

factions.name: Discord-Forged
factions.description: Aberrations and warped constructs born from raw Discord energy: riftspawn, geometry-warped horrors, war-forged titans.
goals: resist attempts at containment or banishment

factions.name: War-Shades
factions.description: Temporal echoes of fallen warriors and battles, existing across overlapping time states.
goals: anchor or destabilize local time depending on resonance
